# Only a bare 10-digit phone number finds anyone

**Claim.** The comparison is against the stored 10-digit string, so `(907) 555-0137` is accepted as valid input and then silently matches no one. There is no error to catch — a formatted number just looks like a person who is not there.

Applies to: `~1people/get`

## Observed exchange

_A person reachable at one phone number._

```http
(setup) POST /people/create

{
  "firstName": "Dashiell",
  "lastName": "Dialtest-{scope}",
  "phones": [
    {
      "phoneNumber": "9075550137"
    }
  ]
}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Stored"
}
```

_Bare 10 digits: found._

GET /people?lastName=Dialtest-{scope}&phoneNumber=9075550137
